banner.title: mglru-disable
banner.tagline: Rewrites the kernel's MGLRU switch to 0 every five minutes, so the multi-generational LRU stays off on every node.

explainer.title: Set at boot, reasserted on a loop

steps.title: Boot
steps.text: Talos machine.sysfs writes kernel/mm/lru_gen/enabled as 0 when the node starts. That is the first layer.
steps.scene: a node block with a switch set to off

steps.title: Reassert
steps.text: This DaemonSet writes the same 0 every 300 seconds, if the file is writable. That is the second layer.
steps.scene: a clock ring resetting a switch

steps.title: Reach
steps.text: The pod is privileged and mounts the host /sys read-write. No other manifest in this repo mounts host /sys.
steps.scene: a locked hatch into a sysfs panel

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: Both layers stay until a reboot proves sysfs alone holds. Removing either one is a separate decision.
steps.scene: two stacked locks on a node
